GraceUXGuidelines.Rationale: Mark is a document editor with WYSIWYG, source, project, diff, terminal, import/export, update, and extension-host surfaces.

MigrationProvenance.Policy: Semantic copy into GRACE 4 current state; legacy sources remain byte-for-byte as migration provenance.

Guidelines.ContentFirst: Editor mode, view, sidebar, live reload, clipboard, and extension operations never silently lose or rewrite document content.
Guidelines.ExplicitRisk: External links, shell paths, rich clipboard content, imports, and security-sensitive actions expose confirmation or a clear blocked state.
Guidelines.LocalTruth: File, watcher, save, diff, recent-document, and project states reflect persisted or observed local truth rather than optimistic UI assumptions.
Guidelines.AccessibleControls: Core editing, navigation, command palette, menu, update, and recovery controls remain keyboard-usable and visibly stateful.
Guidelines.PerformanceVisible: Startup, large-document, search, pending-open, and lazy-renderer behavior uses deterministic budgets and observable degradation.
Guidelines.CrossPlatformHonesty: macOS, Windows, and Linux capability differences are explicit; unsupported platform behavior fails closed without false success.
Guidelines.ExtensionIsolation: Extension-host or TokMo integration failure never corrupts the active document or bypasses the typed IPC and permission boundary.
Guidelines.ReleaseContinuity: Installed version, updater state, release metadata, and Homebrew availability remain understandable and consistent to the user.
